subject: Life Skills

source.topic: Personal and Social Well-being: Public safety
source.subtopic: Dangerous places to play: rubbish dumps, train tracks, roads, construction sites

show.line: Never play on train tracks, roads, dumps or building sites. Play in safe places!

rounds.prompt: Why is a rubbish dump dangerous?
Where is a safe place to play?
A ball rolls onto the train tracks. What do you do?
rounds.praise: Leave it and tell a grown-up!

rounds.prompt: Which sign says danger, keep out?

rounds.story: Sipho's friends climb a building site fence. Sipho says no and goes home. Was he wise?

hints: Trains, cars and machines can hurt us.
Choose places grown-ups say are safe.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I'll play on the train tracks.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! Train tracks are dangerous.

parent_line: Knows dangerous places to play and chooses safe ones.
